verdict.rationale: Foreloop provides an embeddable widget (script tag with widget key) that lets users submit feedback directly in-page (foreloop-docs-29, foreloop-docs-18, foreloop-docs-9, foreloop-docs-12), fulfilling the capture-intake intent, but this is an embedded widget rather than a literal link to a separate feedback portal as the story describes. Missing for 10: explicit support for a standalone feedback-portal page/link (vs. only an in-page widget), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the link/widget experience.
